title: Three MAGA Women Who Defined an Era in Congress Are Exiting
summary: Representatives Marjorie Taylor Greene, Lauren Boebert and Nancy Mace embodied a combative, attention-seeking brand of politics that defined the Republican Congress.
body_markdown: Representatives Marjorie Taylor Greene, Lauren Boebert and Nancy Mace embodied a combative, attention-seeking brand of politics that defined the Republican Congress.
